_comment: THE HAULER DEPOT (#376): where a Scrap Hauler lives. Blueprint-gated (ruling 12). Plating for
the shell, a Machine Frame, a Battery for the buffer it charges the Hauler from, and copper pipe
for the bus the generators feed. Deliberately no Solar Panel: RF is optional (ruling 8) because
the docked Hauler trickles from sky light on its own, so the Depot does not need to carry one.
